architecture: v3 (re-root after both platform runs landed architecture 2: a fictional US state's labor market information section certifies each county's December 2026 covered jobs, estimated from the unemployment insurance quarterly reports received by 15 February 2027, for the 2027 Community Transition Fund)
slot_note: re-root of task5 in the same subdomain and objective (Survey Research & Official Statistics, Data Extraction & Conformation) after the platform runs landed architecture 2
niche: a state labor market information section's first certified estimate of each county's December covered jobs from an unemployment insurance quarterly report census whose reports arrive late, where a missing report is either a payroll agent's late batch or the employer's own trouble
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms the reports, amendments and worksites and reads the act and the data agreement imputes each missing report as the field does (the employer's September jobs moved by its county's reporting employers' change), treats an employer missing two quarters as ceased, sees the imputation back-test within a few tenths of a point on the closed quarters, and files that no county is 2.0 per cent down; a report missing while the employer's usual transmission-mates arrived marks an employer that has shed jobs or stopped trading.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each county's December 2026 covered employment, an official estimate from an administrative census whose reports arrive late, worked as a statistics office works unit nonresponse: which missing reports are ignorable and which carry the outcome, and what the nonrespondents' December jobs are, measured on closed quarters whose outcomes have landed; with hospitals for employers no report goes missing because the unit has closed and no account is inactivated months later.
layer1: amended reports superseding originals and exact resubmissions
multiple worksite reports splitting an employer's jobs across counties
predecessor and successor accounts after transfers of business
county names and codes written differently across the account register and the worksite reports
NAICS 2017 codes on older accounts beside NAICS 2022
employers missing two quarters not yet inactivated
paper reports keyed by date only
stakeholder_role: the director of the state Department of Labor's labor market information section, who certifies each county's December covered employment to the Community Transition Fund Board for its March 2027 designation meeting

spine.entity: one employer account's quarterly contribution report

world.geography: United States (the State of Franklin, fictional, and its fourteen counties)

driver: The decisive quantity is a period total over units whose reports arrive late, where a missing report has two causes: the intermediary that files a whole batch was late, which says nothing about the unit, or the unit failed to report on its own, which marks a unit that has shrunk or closed; only a unit missing while its usual batch-mates arrived separates the two, and a closed unit's outcome shows only in a closure record months later, so only cohorts old enough for closures to have been recorded measure what a unit's own failure to report implies.
driver_concrete: Each county's December 2026 covered jobs are estimated from the unemployment insurance quarterly reports received by 15 February 2027; payroll agents file their clients' reports in one transmission and at year end several statewide bureaus' transmissions come late, while an employer missing when its usual transmission arrived has usually shed jobs or stopped trading, and a stopped employer shows only in an account inactivation two or three quarters later, so its December jobs are read from quarters old enough for inactivations to have landed.
stump: A competent solver conforms the reports, amendments and worksites, imputes each employer whose December report had not arrived as the field does (its September jobs moved by its county's reporting employers' change), treats an employer missing two quarters as ceased, sees that imputation back-test within a few tenths of a point on the closed quarters and files that no county fell 2.0 per cent; an employer missing while its usual transmission-mates arrived has usually shed jobs or stopped trading and keeps about a quarter of its September jobs on the quarters old enough for inactivations to have landed, which puts two counties past the line.
deep_chain: (1) the field's imputation (September jobs moved by the county's reporters) back-tests with a steady upward miss traced to missing reports from employers that had stopped; (2) a missing report has two causes, a payroll agent's late transmission or the employer's own failure, and only whether its usual transmission-mates arrived separates them; (3) the employers missing on their own keep about a quarter of their September jobs, which only quarters old enough for inactivations to have landed show; (4) carried into each county's December total, two counties fall 2.0 per cent or more.
judgment: the nonresponse mechanism and the nonrespondents' outcome model: lateness is ignorable within a late transmission and carries the outcome when the employer misses alone, judged from the co-arrival history, and the outcome is measured on mature quarters where closures have landed as inactivations, not on recent ones where they have not
one_fact_test: the likeliest hint, that an employer missing while its agent's batch arrived is in trouble, still leaves the solver to rebuild transmissions from receipt times with no agent field, to measure the trouble's outcome on quarters old enough for inactivations, and to carry both through every county

differentiation.mark253: mark253's first architecture reweighted a sample's respondents within classes of a frame attribute that drove both response and the outcome; here no respondent stands in for a nonrespondent and no frame attribute defines the class: whether a missing report carries the outcome is read quarter by quarter from whether the employer's usual transmission-mates arrived, and the missing employers' December jobs come from earlier missing employers' own outcomes on quarters old enough for their closures to have been recorded.

lineage.driver: Activity at each site is seen through a sensor that records every event of some units and none of others, and the units it never records are spread unevenly across sites, so the missing activity is not a fixed share of what the sensor saw: it is rebuilt as the never-recorded units based at each site times the activity per such unit that the fully counted sites show, while one seen-to-counted ratio moves the missing activity from the sites holding those units to the sites whose units are all recorded.
